lines.text: The answer is B. Oh. That is the right answer. you have the right answer. Yes. Yes, that is the right answer. Very good guess. lines.text: Fine. Teri shakal dekh ke flush karne ka mann karta hai. Ajay Devgan ka thooka hua Vimal. KRK ki moochh ka dandruff. Vinod Kambli ki kanghi.
